EmailTemplate.subject: Thank you for your interest in the Family and Human Development MA at ASU!
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!Contact.FirstName},
Thank you for your interest in the Family and Human Development Online Master’s Program! Please review the program handbook for information on the admission process, required courses, program timeline, capstone project and more.
Applications are accepted on a rolling basis for entry in fall, spring or summer semesters. The application deadlines by semester can be found online. Be sure to bookmark this page and check back regularly for updates.
Once you have reviewed the handbook, please email me with any questions you may have.
Start your application today.
Thank you and we look forward to hearing from you!
Gina Perez, M.Ed. Graduate Programs Coordinator T. Denny Sanford School of Social and Family Dynamics {!Case.Thread_Id}
